goal: Stop redundant cache invalidation and UI notifications when wallet outputs are spent
Avoids unnecessary GUI refreshes and dead balance recomputation logic left over from prior refactoring
agreement: Support for dropping dead work since transaction caches do not change on spend (pablomartin4btc, Bicaru20)
Welcomed as removing confusing cache invalidation calls (rkrux)
Nonblocking objection: keypool expansion during spend leaves parent credit outdated, no reply (w0xlt)

categories.name: wallet
why: P3 because it cleans up dead work and unneeded GUI notifications left after earlier wallet changes
Benefit is internal cleanup with minor performance gains from skipping no-op cache refreshes
